Forensic Anthropology: It is the branch of forensic science that deals with the study of body human remains of (deceased human beings) for the whole purpose of identification.

Ex- working on a skull recovered from a crime scene, and identifying to whom it belongs is under Forensic Anthropology.

Significance of Anthropology in Forensic Science:
- It helps in the identification of certain individual.
- Can help in classifying people on basis of their

--- Page 3 ---
race, sex and age.
From the help of somatometry and somatoscopy we can tell about the characteristics of any individual.
we get to know about race and every band in the skeletal system:
• Their nose. Their formation. Their shape.
• Facial reconstruction can also be done if we recover skull as an evidence of any part of skull.
• It becomes easy to closely differentiate males and females if we have after noun skull of, normally or pelvis.

Somatometry : It is the process in which measurements of body parts like- Nose, ear, head, face is done for the purpose of personal identification.

Head : The two most end points of skull are considered for the measurement of Head.

Nose : Nose of an individual is measure in two ways
. The length of nose from (n, to, ny)
. The width of nose from (a, to, as)

--- Page 5 ---
Face:
Face measurement of face is a way in which we measure distance between two zygomatic bones called (bizygomatic measurement) face(a to a)

There are some of the measurements and few others are:
- face width
- nasal breadth
- nasal plane

Forensic Significance:
- It helps to identify individuals (suspect) if we have the data already.
- It might also help in catching criminals that might have undergone any type of plastic surgery.

--- Page 6 ---
• It helps in forensic examination across diverse population as it will be easy to classify people into groups according to their race.

• Portrait Face / Bertillon system:
Portrait Face and Bertillon System are two different methods of measurements but are used / used as are for better results.

• Where Portrait Face focuses on by the facial structure, Bertillon System is followed by the body measurements like height Body structure etc.

L There are doubt on the statement of witness if it may vary (may be a little or lot) with other one, where biometric recognizes the fact same.

S As biometric is not available everywhere, it is best to rely on Facial Face / Baudilon system

L Facial appearance can be changed by surgery which will make facial face easy to cheat, but biometric can't be changed (e.g. fingerprints)

--- Page 8 ---
Facial Reconstruction:
It is a method / process in which the face of an individual is reconstructed with the help of skull. Skull parts for identification.
It is mainly done in cases like mass disaster an recovering some part of skull from crime scene.
There are various forensic reconstruction techniques like 3-D reconstruction imagery, X-Ray radiography, video laparoscopy, X-Ray comparison.
They are mainly categorized in two parts:
1) Manual
2) Digital

--- Page 9 ---
Manual : This includes priors like image spectroscopy, or video spectroscopy, etc.

Image : In image spectroscopy the image of the skull is overlapped with the image of the suspected person for identification.

Video : It is same as image spectroscopy but the only difference is that we take videos of the skull and the person, then use for reconstruction.

X-ray : In the X-ray of the skull is taken along with the X-ray of person's head and then matched together.

Digital : Digital methods are more advanced and accurate than manual methods as there might be any miscalculation while overlapping. It's more reliable.

Like - Sonarization : when a person's face is scanned.

Human Skeleton

Now born babies usually have 300-400 bones.
As a baby grows and becomes older the number of bones get reduced to 206.

Main function of human skeleton:
- Provide structure to the body.
- Protects vital organs.
- Supports our body weight.

There are various types of bones like:
- Long Bones
- Flat bones
- Short Bones
- Irregular
- Sesamoid Bones

--- Page 12 ---
(1) Long Bones:
(2) Short bones:
(3) Irregular bones:
(4) Flat bone:
(5) Sesamoid bone:

There are different type of joints in human skeleton too.
(1) Immovable
(2) Slightly movable
(3) Fully movable.

--- Page 13 ---
• Immovable joints that don't move at all
• Slightly movable joints that partially move
• Fully movable joints that are freely movable.

Sex Determination from skull:
Sex Determination with the help of the skull is one of the crucial ways in which an individual can be helped in identification of whether it's a male or female.

- larger than female skull

- smaller than male skull
- Muscle attachment is weak in comparison to male
- Mandibular angle is more rounded
- Chin is V-shaped

Forensic odontology : It is the branch of forensic science that deals with the study of teeth. (maintaining human being.

Role in Mass Disaster:

When there is a mass disaster situation like land slide, earthquake etc. It becomes very difficult to find clues or evidence for the identification of people.

So forensic odontology is opted as one of the ways because as we know teeth are very strong and easily they cannot be altered in any way.

--- Page 17 ---
- All with teeth we can also find the victim
Age of the individual by many like
Total no of Teeth present, the condition of teeth (caries), they are of a child, adult an old age person)
Dental Records are used for identify victim Identification when other method fails in a way that:
Dental records include whether there is any anomaly that cannot be fixed completely.
- These include - when there is extra teeth
- when there is no teeth
- when there is one or more teeth on attractive
- when there has been had any any
Dental procedure like capping, RCT.

--- Page 18 ---
• All these Anamnesis are absolute and cannot be completely fixed it becomes easy for the conclude victim identification.

Qx- The victim might not be in any condition for identification (in case of a mass disaster like bomb blast)

But

The face is completely charred, so if any part of dental records are available we can go for the forensic Odontology as it are too strong that they already mentioned to be easily affected.

Somatometry : It is the method / way of measurement of different body parts like body weight, tall, waist, ear, height, head circumference for the purpose of physical identification.

Some somatometric measurement are:
Height: The measured should be the when the person is standing straight and still. from head to toe. or from A1 to A2.

--- Page 20 ---
a) Face - For face the measurement is done from one zygomatic bone to the other zygomatic (called bizygomatic measurement)
gx - from z1 to z2

b) Nose - As for the measurement of nose, two measurements are conducted: length and width.
Length L1 to L2
Width W1 to W2

Facial Superimposition Techniques
There are various Facial superimposition Techniques that include
(1) Image spectroscopy
(2) Video spectroscopy
(3) X-ray superimposition.

Image spectroscopy: In this an image of the suspected person is taken along with the skull that is recovered and
Then they are superimposed on each

- And likewise the too are superimposed on each other.
- X-Ray superposing: In this they X ray of both and the person's X-ray of face is superimposed X-ray and each other.
